## Summary
Verify reproducibility and no regressions; compile the final evaluation report (parent: LP-0MTAQNB7J0094X71).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Full project test suite passes with no regressions (parent AC #6).
- All scripts rerunnable end-to-end from a log snapshot; corpus regenerates cleanly.
- Final evaluation report compiled (parent AC #1-#5 sections), posted to parent work item.
- No source code changed in proxy/ds4 (parent AC #5).




- **Validation**: Reproducible analysis scripts; full project test suite passes with no regressions. (covers parent AC #6)
- **No code change without approval**: Evaluation and plan only; implementation tracked as a follow-up work item. (covers parent AC #5)

## Minimal Implementation
- Run the full test suite (/skill:test) after analysis scripts land; triage any failures per policy.
- Re-run F1 corpus generation from a fresh snapshot to prove reproducibility.
- Assemble root-cause, metric, triage, and recommendation sections into the final report on the parent.

## Key Files
- scripts/ (all analysis scripts from F1)
- parent work item LP-0MTAQNB7J0094X71



## Dependencies
LP-0MTCMEJX2008W85X (F1), LP-0MTCMEOHB002X1JN (F2), LP-0MTCMEV1G0022A35 (F3), LP-0MTCMG18A008ZKVT (F4), LP-0MTCMGJBM007AQ55 (F5).
